sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This policy applies to Global NovaTech staff and authorized stakeholders. Deployment SOP is maintained by ENG Operations.

sections.heading: Policy requirement
sections.text: Deploy requires peer review, green CI, change ticket and on-call owner.

sections.heading: Implementation steps
sections.text: 1. Log the request, business purpose, owner, and applicable region. 2. Verify the current policy version and eligibility. 3. Obtain the designated approval before execution. 4. Record the outcome and evidence in the department tracking system. 5. Escalate exceptions to ENG Operations.

sections.heading: Worked example
sections.text: A staff member asks about deployment sop. The reviewer checks the rule above, validates employee scope, records approvals, and follows the related procedure in PROD-005. Do not use superseded guidance for current requests.

sections.heading: Controls and exceptions
sections.text: Exceptions need written approval from ENG Operations. Confidential or Restricted material must only be retrieved for entitled roles. The owning team reviews the policy annually.

sections.heading: Cross-department handoff
sections.text: For overlapping questions, consult PROD-005. If policies disagree, use the active version effective on the relevant date and escalate unresolved conflicts to the owners.
